output.question: Has LinkedIn announced layoffs?
output.answer: Yes. The most recent round was in mid-May 2026. On May 13, 2026, Reuters reported, citing an unnamed source, that LinkedIn planned to cut about 5% of its global staff, roughly 875 jobs, while reorganizing teams around the parts of its business that are growing. LinkedIn confirmed the changes but never gave a number. A spokesperson said only that 'as part of our regular business planning, we've implemented organisational changes.' The one official count is from California: five WARN notices dated May 15, 2026 cover 606 workers, effective July 13, 2026. About 78 jobs were also reported at risk in Ireland. I found no reports of a newer round between June and early November 2026.

key_facts.fact: Reuters reported, citing an anonymous source, that LinkedIn plans to cut about 5% of staff globally as it reorganizes teams and focuses on areas where the business is growing. The source said AI replacing jobs was not the reason.
A LinkedIn spokesperson confirmed 'organisational changes' as part of regular business planning but gave no headcount.
About 78 jobs were understood to be at risk at LinkedIn's Irish operation, which employs just over 1,800 people.

California WARN notices: five notices dated May 15, 2026, effective July 13, 2026, covering 606 workers (Mountain View 352, San Francisco 108, Mountain View home office 66, Sunnyvale 59, Carpinteria 21).
The cuts reportedly affected product, design/research and LinkedIn Learning content production, including closing the office in Graz, Austria. Reported totals were over 800 employees, about 5%.
LinkedIn revenue rose 12% year over year in the quarter just ended, according to Microsoft filings.
Earlier rounds: 281 California WARN cuts in May 2025, about 668 in October 2023, and about 700 earlier in 2023. The tracker lists no events after May 2026 (status as of August 26, 2026).

passages.quote: plans to cut about 5% of staff globally as it reorganises teams
As part of our regular business planning, we've implemented organisational changes
The layoff rationale was not for artificial intelligence to replace jobs
It is understood that 78 jobs are under threat at LinkedIn's Irish operation.
implemented organizational changes to best position ourselves for future success

caveats: LinkedIn never confirmed the 5% or ~875 figure. Reuters reported that a spokesperson disputed the 5% number. Outlets give totals ranging from 'over 800' to about 1,000.
The 606 figure counts California WARN notices only and is not a global total. It comes from a third-party tracker that summarizes state filings, not from the filings themselves.
Some outlets tie the cuts to AI restructuring, while Reuters' source said AI replacing jobs was not the reason.
I found no reports of layoffs after May 2026, but a round announced in the last few weeks may not be indexed yet.
